scope: Browser-only globe visual experiment for Azeroth. No globe projection is installed in the addon. The separate experimental map flag is implemented in the addon.
inputs: Real GGT Lua renderer, native Blizzard art, fully revealed accepted Northrend zone masks/hatching; same geographic placements as the flat world scene. Prototype-only Scene forces Northrend painted detail at world scale for a two-level atlas. No reference-addon code or assets. The close endpoint uses a separate full-resolution accepted Northrend root render, preventing low world-atlas density from limiting local detail.
projection: Schematic equirectangular placement of the existing illustrated map on a sphere, with drag rotation/tilt and zoom. The surface transitions to a local flat projection before close painted detail to avoid polar distortion of letters and coastlines. It does not establish canonical planetary latitude/longitude.
coverage: Azeroth world painting, one Northrend painted-detail atlas blend and the accepted local Northrend root painting. Close minimap terrain, alt markers, other worlds and native interaction/performance are outside this browser prototype.
browser_verification: Headless Chrome/SwiftShader: shader compiled; all three source images loaded; focus/zoom/reset and flat comparison changed pixels; QA valid true, no reported errors. Wide viewport and true 320-pixel iframe inspected. Close endpoint transitions into the existing local Northrend composition. Screenshots under .local/visualizations.
native_feasibility_inference: The client exposes texture corner offsets (SetVertexOffset); a tessellated 2.5D overview followed by the existing flat renderer is a plausible route to investigate. A browser custom shader cannot be assumed to run in the WoW UI. Native masks, limb clipping, marker projection and texture budgets must be implemented and tested separately.
